notes.title: Bug Fix: Dead wood can be used anywhere on 3rd floor
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Now you can only use deadwood in front of the altar.

Seldom Ludious

notes.title: Bug Fix: Red and white curtains overlapping
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Hope you guys still doing well. Now when you try to use a red or white curtain on an existing curtain will not happen anything. 

I'm really sorry about this inconvenience. 

Sincerely,
Seldom Ludious

notes.title: Bug Fix: Shutter can be used underground.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Hope you guys still enjoy the game. I just found a bug, it allows you to use the first shutter underground.

Maybe you haven't found that bug yet but it was there and it just got fixed.

I apologize for the inconvenience.

Thank you guys for playing this game, I really appreciate your supports.

Sincerely,
Seldom Ludious

notes.title: Release Date Confirmed
notes.notes:
Dear players and friends,

The expected release date for R.I.C.A is Feb 7th, 2019.

But now I have confirmed that the SCHEDULED RELEASE DATE is Feb 15th, 2019.

I am very sorry for the delay, and R.I.C.A will be online for download on Feb 15th!

Thank you for your support, and I hope you will enjoy the game.

Sincerely,
Seldom Ludious
